app.title: CorroScope | Corrosion Research
app.summary: A person enters one specimen's measurements into a form: masses before and after exposure, density, exposed area and exposure time. Or they enter corrosion current density, equivalent weight and density. The interface computes mass loss and corrosion rate in mm/year, shows the equation and a worked breakdown, and lets them save the result to a session experiment log. They can also compare a blank rate with an inhibited rate to get percentage inhibition efficiency. The log collects saved, manual and imported records in a table they export as CSV. A separate page keeps searchable literature notes.

task.text: Turn gravimetric or electrochemical measurements on a specimen into a corrosion rate and an inhibitor's efficiency, and keep the results in an exportable experiment log.

data.text: Hand-entered measurements per specimen (masses, density, area, time, or current density and equivalent weight), the corrosion rates computed from them, kept as rows of an experiment log, plus free-text reference notes with keywords.
data.item: one specimen exposure test, recorded as a row of the experiment log

stage.text: computing corrosion rates from finished exposure or polarization measurements, before reporting

mechanism.text: A sidebar radio switches between calculator pages. Each one has an input form beside a results panel with metrics, the governing equation and a calculation breakdown, and a save button there appends the result to a session log. The log page shows every record in a table with manual entry, CSV import with a preview, and CSV export, and a notes page saves references and filters them with a keyword search.

field.text: gravimetric and electrochemical corrosion-rate calculation and inhibitor testing in corrosion science

workflow.name: compute a derived quantity from entered measurements and log each result

steps.here: Measurements are typed into a form: initial and final mass, density, exposed area and exposure time, or corrosion current density, equivalent weight and density.

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: Calculate gives mass loss in g and mg and a corrosion rate in mm/year from CR = 87.6W/(ρAt) or CR = 0.00327·Icorr·EW/ρ. The inputs are checked first, and a final mass above the initial mass is rejected.
A blank corrosion rate and an inhibited corrosion rate give a percentage inhibition efficiency, with a message saying whether the inhibitor lowered or raised the rate.

Save result to experiment log appends a dated row with an EXP-#### id. Records can also be added by hand with a specimen label, test medium and notes, or appended from an imported CSV after a preview.
The session log downloads as corroscope_experiments.csv. Literature notes download as their own CSV.

distinctive: Each result shows the governing equation in LaTeX and a line-by-line breakdown of the inputs with their units.
Two methods, gravimetric and electrochemical, produce the same quantity (mm/year), so their results land in one log.
Inhibition efficiency is allowed to be negative and is flagged as a sign to check the experimental conditions.
Records live only in the session, so CSV export and re-import is how the work is kept between sessions.
A keyword-searchable literature-notes page sits next to the calculators.

parts.title: Workspace navigation
parts.summary: A sidebar radio list, plus home-page shortcut buttons and record counts, that switches between the calculators, the log and the notes.

parts.title: Weight Loss Analysis
parts.summary: A form for specimen masses and exposure conditions, beside a results panel that shows mass loss, corrosion rate, the equation and a calculation breakdown, with a button to save the result to the log.

parts.title: Electrochemical Analysis
parts.summary: A form for corrosion current density, equivalent weight and density that estimates corrosion rate in mm/year, shows the working, and saves the result to the log.

parts.title: Inhibition Efficiency
parts.summary: Compares a blank corrosion rate with an inhibited one, gives the percentage inhibition efficiency, and says whether the inhibitor helped.

parts.title: Data & Experiments
parts.summary: Shows every session record in a table, with a form for manual records, CSV import with a preview before appending, CSV export, and a button to clear the log.

parts.title: Literature Notes
parts.summary: Saves reference notes with a title and keywords, filters them with a text search over title, note and keywords, and exports them as CSV.
